beats.say: Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium.
The Bayern Munich forward claimed the trophy on 26 October 2026.
Thirty players were nominated for the Men's award and thirty for the Féminin award.
Each candidate delivered memorable performances on the pitch throughout the entire footballing year.
Supporters reacted around the globe as the final rankings were confirmed across both lists.
Out of sixty total nominees selected, Kane stood alone at the very top of world football.
He secured a historic personal achievement in London. Sport Shocks covers giant football moments; subscribe so you never miss the next one. Fans cheered when

facts: The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium in London.
Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or for the first time.
Thirty players were nominated for the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or.
Thirty players were nominated for the 2026 Ballon d'Or Féminin.
